opportunities.name: Determination health drain
opportunities.objective: Test determination health drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: The Darkin Glaive heals 5-9% max health on its first attack; Bloodmail adds AD from purchased health and Visage supports that heal plus Grim Deliverance's damage-based healing. Repeated W/E/Q contacts build twelve Determination stacks before the conditional revive, but exact passive AD values are unresolved.
opportunities.requiredState: Reach twelve real stacks before lethal damage with revive available.
opportunities.failure: Burst before full stacks or healing reduction removes the safety net.
opportunities.test: Measure Q healing and time to twelve stacks against a mobile target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Revive is not always active and its unresolved health fraction cannot be invented.

opportunities.name: Glaive attack weave
opportunities.objective: Test glaive attack weave against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: The Darkin Glaive's first empowered attack slashes twice and its recast knocks up; Trinity adds one physical Spellblade while Blade and Terminus test personal attack pressure. Hexplate supports attacks after R, with edge E providing a mixed physical and max-health magic packet.
opportunities.requiredState: Land Q attacks between E spacing and use R before the attack-speed window.
opportunities.failure: Less raw AD weakens the 2.0 AD[source modifier] ultimate burst.
opportunities.test: Compare Q attack packets and stack gain with item effects logged separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Two slashes do not prove double full on-hits or two automatic Determination stacks.

ruledOut.reason: Revive is not always active and its unresolved health fraction cannot be invented.

unknowns: Current-patch proc ordering/effectiveness is untested; symbolic source stats and helper form/pet records are not runtime dispatch proof.

builds.summary: Test determination health drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test determination health drain against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: The Darkin Glaive heals 5-9% max health on its first attack; Bloodmail adds AD from purchased health and Visage supports that heal plus Grim Deliverance's damage-based healing. Repeated W/E/Q contacts build twelve Determination stacks before the conditional revive, but exact passive AD values are unresolved.
testPlan: Required state: Reach twelve real stacks before lethal damage with revive available.
Measure Q healing and time to twelve stacks against a mobile target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Burst before full stacks or healing reduction removes the safety net.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Revive is not always active and its unresolved health fraction cannot be invented.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Spear of Shojin, Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver, Spirit Visage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Zaahen gains a stack of Determination when he hits an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability (max [12]). He gains [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw)] increased Attack Damage per stack.

When filled with Determination, Zaahen doubles the granted Attack Damage, and if he would die, he instead enters Stasis for [4] seconds then revives with [UNRESOLVED({4ce08984}; see calculationRaw)] of his max Health.

Zaahen's revive has a [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=300, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -60.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -60.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -60.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] second Cooldown.

Zaahen slashes twice on his next Attack, dealing [15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / 75 + (0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] bonus physical damage and restoring [(0.05 / 0.06 / 0.07 / 0.08 / 0.09) × 100]% of his max Health.

Recast: Zaahen's next Attack deals [30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 + (0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × AD[statFormula=2]] bonus physical damage and Knocks the target Up for [0.75] seconds.

Zaahen dashes then slices around himself, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to nearby enemies.

Enemies at the edge of the slice take [(40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (1.5)] physical damage +[(0.04 / 0.045 / 0.05 / 0.055 / 0.06) × 100]% of their maximum Health as magic damage instead.

Passive: Zaahen gains [(0.1 / 0.2 / 0.3) × 100]% %i:scaleAPen% Armor Penetration.

Active: Zaahen rises, gaining [50]% Damage Reduction while casting.

Zaahen then stabs downward, dealing [250 / 400 / 550 + (2) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage and restoring [33]% of the damage dealt to enemy champions as Health.

Zaahen stabs in a direction, dealing [40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 + (0.5) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage to enemies hit, then Pulls them toward him, dealing [30 / 50 / 70 / 90 / 110 + (0.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage.
